tagline: Finds, proves, fixes and verifies security bugs, with a human in control
how_it_works: Triage scans the code and finds the risky function and the route that reaches it
The exploit agent writes an attack test, and the sandbox proves it fails (red)
The patch agent writes a fix, guided by retrieved security notes (RAG) and past runs (memory)
The verifier re-runs the attack test and the original tests, which must all pass (green)
A human reviews the diff and approves, and the run is saved to long-term memory

tech_stack.purpose: Runs the agents as a graph with retry loops and routing
Writes exploit tests and patches, answers questions
Call graph, reachability and vulnerability detection
Runs generated tests in an isolated container
Three intentionally vulnerable sample apps and their regression tests
Finds relevant security guidance, with no extra model needed
Saves every run so later runs can reuse verified fixes
Live logs, call graph, diff view and approval
